scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && (test -d server/venv && ./server/venv/bin/pip install -r server/requirements.txt || pip install -r server/requirements.txt)
scripts.dev:server: cd server && (test -f venv/bin/uvicorn && ./venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 || uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000)
